surface.label: Orders
surface.purpose: The shop floor's queue of production jobs: what is being made, on which machine, by when, and which request it came from

order.label: Order
order.description: One production job: what is made, on what machine, by when, and where it came from

create.label: Create order
create.description: Put a job on the queue directly. A job that comes from a request is created by converting the request instead, so that the link between the two exists.

updateStatus.label: Change status
updateStatus.description: Move a job along: queued, in progress, paused, completed, cancelled or blocked.

assign.label: Assign to a machine
assign.description: Put a job on a machine and book the slot in that machine's schedule. Without an end time the job's due date is used; a job with neither has to be told one.

errors.noOrder: An order has to be in context.
errors.noEndAt: Say when the slot ends, or give the job a due date.

printing.title: Printing
printing.description: Orders on the machines right now

progress.title: In progress
progress.description: Share of orders being worked on

overview.hint: Press Orders for the queue itself.
